about: The AE tactical SMG pack: CMT's TSC:E tactical SMG (the evolved set's smg_tactical: a suppressed SMG with a red-dot optic and a zoom; art, animations and sounds, credited) made into a donor map and the pack. The model CMT made carries first-person arms and two flashlight cones: the third-person model is it with the arms and the cones taken out, the first-person model the same (the arms in first person are the stock cyborg's) (make_pack.py's model_parts step: the model's last parts, byte for byte). Its numbers are PROVISIONAL (the first set, for the owner to retune in play). The zoom overlay is CMT's own with the labels left out. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

stock_derived.ae\\packs\\smg_tactical\\hud\\smg_ammo: layout numbers set by AE, from the stock assault rifle HUD's structure: positions, sizes and references (hud_tag.py), no art

source.name: CMT's The Silent Cartographer: Evolved 1.4.1c source release

tools.ffmpeg: n9.0.2 (decodes the Ogg Vorbis permutations to 16-bit PCM)
tools.art: Python 3.14 with Pillow 12.2.0 and numpy 2.4.4 drew the art pinned below (each by its decoded pixels, mode and size, not by its file)

steps.why: the donor map: Blood Gulch's scenario without vehicles, the weapon in its weapon palette
the pickup and HUD message indices the stock assault rifle's (CMT's point into CMT's own HUD texts)
the Xbox's model format; its parts had no compressed vertices, which the Xbox's build needs
The prompts' picture is CMT's own: its pickup icon sheet, sequence 15 (the silenced SMG).
the ammunition panel: the counter of 60 rounds (counter_art.py), the low-ammo flash on it, the prompts' picture off the screen
CMT's art is dark in stock CE's lighting: the base map brightened as the battle rifle's

the third-person model's source: CMT's tactical SMG without its last three parts, the first-person arms (the ODST rubber material) and the two flashlight cones, and their three shaders (model_parts.py: byte for byte, nothing else of the tag changes: a JMS round trip drew the first-person rig wrong)

the first-person model's source: the same model without its last three parts, as the third-person one (CMT's ODST arms and the flashlight cones, and their three shaders), under its own tag name: the arms in first person are the stock cyborg's, as the other SMG packs have (owner 2026-11-04)
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)

the body's lighting tuned beside the battle rifle's in the game; its reflection cube map was a campaign map's (levels\a10\bitmaps\cube map glass): the warthog's metal cube map, which every stock multiplayer map has, as the battle rifle's metal
its reflection cube map is a campaign map's (levels\a10\bitmaps\cube map glass): the stock cyborg's mirror cube map, which every stock multiplayer map has, as the battle rifle's silencer shader
its reflection cube map is the grunt's (characters\grunt\bitmaps\reflection grunt diffuse), which no stock multiplayer map has: the stock cyborg's mirror cube map

CMT's interface with the ammunition panel ours (the child HUD), the hip aiming reticle ours (the SMG's, drawn from geometry, in CE's colour, red on target) and the zoom overlay CMT's own lines without the labels (smg_scope.py); the second reticle, the zoomed one, left out (the scope's lines are the zoomed sight) and CMT's zoom screen effect (a green night-vision tint and a blur, which the other packs' scopes have none of) taken off

PROVISIONAL numbers (the first set, for the owner to retune in play): 13 rounds a second, a magazine of 48 with 144 to start and 144 in reserve at most, error 1 to 4 degrees (a shot at least 0.3 off) reached in 1 s and lost in 0.25 s (steadier than the SMG's 1.5 to 5.5), aim assist 6 degrees / 12 units and magnetism 12 / 18 as the SMG's, one zoom level at 2x (CMT's 3x; the SMG's range does not need more), the zoom sounds the stock sniper rifle's; the bullet the SMG's (the stock assault rifle's projectile and damage effect, edited below); the held weapon's collision and melee the stock assault rifle's, its damage and response tags left to the map; no night vision; CMT's flashlight attachment left out (nothing in the first-person model lights); the second pack's ammunition box (the SMG's)

The tactical SMG's bullet, PROVISIONAL: the SMG's (400 units a second, close-range falloff) with a longer reach: it slows to 220 (not 160) and reaches 55 units (not 40). Spartans' armour and skin take the stock assault rifle's smaller impact effects
The tactical SMG at launch in feel, PROVISIONAL: 12 a round up close (the SMG's), 6.5 once the round has slowed (the SMG's 4.4): it keeps more at mid range; no head bonus

a bullet's kick on the pad (haptics, 2026-11-03): the SMG's light fast pulse on both motors, a little lighter for 0.06 s a round (15 a second: a soft buzz); CMT's view kick and shake are left as they are

expected.about: recorded from a build of revision 1 (2026-11-04: the first set of numbers, PROVISIONAL; the models cut from CMT's tactical SMG model, the zoom overlay CMT's lines without the labels); a pack built twice from the recipe was the same
